Done — the duty agent answers."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> While on duty, the web UI shows a banner telling you approvals are forwarded to your phone, with a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" one-click switch back."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- 📱 **Task loop** — Telegram message → dedicated "duty" DSH session (its agent has the standard tool"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" set) → final reply back to Telegram; long replies are split under Telegram's message limit.
- ⏳ **I"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"nstant feedback** — every task message is acknowledged immediately ("📨 Received, generating…") and t"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"he phone keeps showing the "typing…" animation until the result arrives; errors report a clear "⚠️ P"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"rocessing error".
- 🎯 **Targeted sessions** — `/sessions` lists your workspace sessions (live and of"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"fline, matching the web sidebar; blank drafts are hidden) with numbered buttons: tap one to route fo"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"llowing messages there. Prefix one message with `#N` to send just that one to session N. `/duty` ret"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"urns to the default duty route. Offline sessions are woken automatically on the first targeted messa"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ge.
- 🔐 **Whitelist** — only your own chat id is served; other senders are logged and ignored.
- ✅ *"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"*Global approval forwarding** — in *duty* mode, approval requests from **all** sessions go to your p"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"hone with **[✅ Approve] [⛔ Reject] buttons** (tap to answer; typing `3 approve / 3 reject` still wor"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"ks). Unanswered approvals time out to *rejected* (fail-closed, 10 minutes by default). `/away` warns"},{"id":"p16s13","text":" when the web UI still holds unanswered approvals, and `/unblock` cancels turns stuck on them.
- ❓ *"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"*telegram_ask tool** — when an agent needs you to choose between options, confirm something, or supp"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"ly missing information, it pushes the question to your phone with **one button per option**; the dut"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"y agent is prompted to prefer it.
- 📣 **telegram_notify tool** — any session's agent can proactively"},{"id":"p16s17","text":" push a message to your phone (reports, reminders, notifications), no waiting required.
- 🔀 **Duty /"},{"id":"p16s18","text":" local toggle**
- Enter duty: send any phone message, send `/away`, or flip `watchMode` in the web s"},{"id":"p16s19","text":"ettings.
- Back to local: send any message in the web UI, or send `/back`.
- In local mode approvals"},{"id":"p16s20","text":" stay in the web popup; in duty mode the popup is paused.
- 🚩 **Duty banner** — while on duty, a fra"},{"id":"p16s21","text":"me-wide web banner shows "approvals are on your phone" with a one-click switch back.

| `chatId` | — | Whitelisted chat id. |"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"
| `proxy` | (empty) | HTTP proxy used for Bot API calls. **Leave empty for a direct connection — on"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ly set a local proxy (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890`) when Telegram is blocked in your network, and ke"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ep that proxy running.** |
| `sessionId` | `telegram-duty` | Stable DSH session id; created on first"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" message. |

| `approvalTimeou"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"tMinutes` | `10` | Unanswered approvals are rejected after this. |
| `watchMode` | `local` | `local`"},{"id":"p20s8","text":" (web popups) or `duty` (approvals to Telegram). |
| `language` | `en` | Language of all Telegram me"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"ssages: `en` or `zh`. |

| `replyChunkChars` | `3800` | Split threshold for long replies (Telegram limit 4096). |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Phone commands"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- `/help` — usage
- `/sessions` — list your workspace sessions (live + offline) with numbered button"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s; tap a number to route following messages there
- `#N message` — send just this one message to ses"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"sion N (numbering from the latest `/sessions`; expires after 30 minutes)
- `/duty` — back to the def"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ault duty-session route
- `/away` — enter duty mode (approvals go to the phone); warns about approva"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ls the web UI still holds
- `/unblock` — cancel turns stuck on unanswered web approvals (resend the "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"task afterwards)
- `/back` — return to local mode
- `3 approve` / `3 reject` — answer approval #3; w"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ith a single pending approval, bare `approve`/`reject` works too."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## FAQ"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **My bot doesn't reply.** Check in order: ① token and chatId are correct; ② you have sent `/start`"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" to the bot at least once (bots cannot message first); ③ the DSH log shows no `telegram-duty` errors"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"; ④ `watchMode`/language behave as expected.
- **How do I find my chat id?** Send any message to @us"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"erinfobot; it replies with your numeric id.
